critical_findings.title: .dockerignore excludes go.mod/go.sum — Docker build fails at COPY step
critical_findings.fix: Remove *.mod and *.sum patterns; add docker build to CI so image breakage is detected

critical_findings.title: All ldflags target dead module path CosmoDev-R2Go2 — version stamping silently no-ops in every artifact
critical_findings.fix: Change -X targets to github.com/CosmoLabs-org/cosmoflare/cmd.* in Makefile:19, Dockerfile:30-32, release.yml:62-64; define the flag string once

critical_findings.title: Release notes and installer point at dead repo CosmoDev-R2Go2
critical_findings.fix: Use github.com/CosmoLabs-org/cosmoflare in release notes go install line and install.sh REPO

critical_findings.title: Installer downloads binary with no checksum verification
critical_findings.fix: Fetch checksums-sha256.txt from the release and verify before chmod +x / install

critical_findings.title: make dist packages 76MB of internal session transcripts into public release archives
critical_findings.fix: Ship only README.md, LICENSE, and docs/USAGE.md in archives

critical_findings.title: No security scanning in CI (no govulncheck, CodeQL, trivy, or dependabot); golangci-lint unpinned at latest
critical_findings.fix: Pin golangci-lint version; add security job with govulncheck and trivy; add dependabot.yml

critical_findings.title: Duplicate test-integration Makefile target — one references dead ./pkg/r2go2/ path, the other hangs CI with interactive read prompt
critical_findings.fix: Delete first definition, fix package path to ./pkg/cosmoflare/, gate prompt on tty

critical_findings.title: Profile API tokens and AWS secret keys persisted as plaintext YAML; keychain module unwired to profile storage
critical_findings.fix: Opt-in flag to store tokens via internal/keychain with reference in YAML; keep 0600 plaintext as headless default

critical_findings.title: Docker builder golang:1.25-alpine lags go.mod go 1.26; alpine:latest unpinned; GOARCH=amd64 hardcoded
critical_findings.fix: Use golang:1.26-alpine, pin alpine by digest, add multi-arch buildx job

recommendations.action: Fix .dockerignore and add docker build CI job
Sweep all CosmoDev-R2Go2 references (ldflags, install paths, release notes) to cosmoflare
Add checksum verification to install.sh; pin golangci-lint version
Add govulncheck + trivy security job and dependabot.yml
Remove docs/ from make dist archives
Dedupe test-integration target and fix package path
Wire internal/keychain into profile save behind opt-in flag
Consolidate test.yml into ci.yml; upload coverage artifact
Rebrand Makefile/Dockerfile/packaging from r2go2 to cosmoflare
Untrack simple-setup/test-setup binaries; exclude GOrchestra recovery patches from public repo

roadmap_suggestions.title: Supply-chain hardening: reproducible, verified releases
roadmap_suggestions.description: Pin CI tool versions, verify installer checksums, run make sbom in release workflow, sign release artifacts

roadmap_suggestions.title: Docker image publishing pipeline
roadmap_suggestions.description: Multi-arch buildx with digest-pinned bases, trivy scan gate, push to ghcr.io on tags; image currently unbuildable and unpublished

roadmap_suggestions.title: Deployment story for cosmoflare serve
roadmap_suggestions.description: Example compose/systemd/k8s artifacts with resource limits and token-auth health checks for the daemon

roadmap_suggestions.title: Rename-debt cleanup: r2go2 to cosmoflare
roadmap_suggestions.description: Single sweep covering Makefile, Dockerfile, DEB/RPM, install scripts, ~/.r2go2 config dir migration, and removal of cicd.go.disabled
